test_title: RRB NTPC - Graduate 2025 (CBT 2) Mid-Range Full Test - 03
subject: general
question:
Refer to the following letter, number, symbol series and answer the question.

(Left) B F % 6 J Q 6 H & K M 8 1 5 T Z # @ K L 9 (Right)

How many such letters are there which are immediately preceded by a letter and also immediately followed by a number ?
solution:
Pattern: Letter **Letter** Number

(Left) B F % 6 **J Q 6** H & **K M 8** 1 5 T Z # @ **K L 9** (Right)

Clearly, three such letters are there which are immediately preceded by a letter and also immediately followed by a number.

Hence, ‘**3**’ is the correct answer.
